source_text: Et uenimus prope locum, cuius loci parietes tales erant quasi de luce aedificati; et ante ostium loci illius angeli quattuor introeuntes uestierunt nos stolas candidas. Et introiuimus, et audiuimus uocem unitam dicentem: Agios, agios, agios, sine cessatione. Et uidimus in eodem loco sedentem quasi hominem canum, niueos habentem capillos et uultu iuuenili, cuius pedes non uidimus. Et in dextera et in sinistra eius seniores quattuor, et post illos ceteri seniores conplures. Introiuimus cum admiratione et stetimus ante thronum, et quattuor angeli subleuauerunt nos, et osculati sumus illum, et de manu sua traiecit nobis in faciem. Et ceteri seniores dixerunt nobis: Stemus ad orationem. Et stetimus et pacem fecimus. Et dixerunt nobis seniores: Ite et ludite. Et dixi Perpetuae: Habes quod uis. Et dixit mihi: Deo gratias, ut, quomodo in carne hilaris fui, hilarior sim et hic modo.
thought_title: Clothed in white and kissed before the throne
orientation: Saturus continues his own vision as the angels bring the martyrs inside to greet the Lord.
pass_a_gloss: And we came near to a place, the walls of which place were such as if built out of light; and before the door of that place four angels as they went in clothed us with white robes. And we went in, and we heard a united voice saying: Holy, holy, holy, without ceasing. And we saw in the same place sitting as if a man white with age, having hairs white as snow and with a youthful face, whose feet we did not see. And on his right and on his left four elders, and behind them the remaining very many elders. We went in with wonder and we stood before the throne, and four angels lifted us up, and we kissed him, and from his hand he passed across to us onto the face. And the remaining elders said to us: Let us stand for prayer. And we stood and we made peace. And the elders said to us: Go and play. And I said to Perpetua: You have what you want. And she said to me: Thanks be to God, so that, as in the flesh I was cheerful, here also in this manner I may be more cheerful.

choices.why: keeps the welcoming in white before the throne stated in the brief, with stola as full robe
renders the retained Greek liturgical acclamation in English rather than leaving it untranslated
marks throne room figures around God, not ordinary old men or church office holders here
keeps the literal imperative to play in heaven, however strange, without softening to worship

pass_b_english: We drew near to a place whose walls looked as though they were built of light. At its doorway four angels met us as we entered and dressed us in white robes. Once inside, we heard a single voice crying without pause, “Holy, holy, holy” (Isaiah 6:3) (Revelation 4:8). Seated in that same place was one who looked like a white-haired man, with hair white as snow and a young face, though we could not see his feet. Four elders stood at his right and his left, and behind them a great many other elders.

We came forward in awe and stood before the throne, and the four angels lifted us up. We kissed him, and he passed his hand across our faces. Then the other elders said to us, “Let us stand for prayer.” So we stood and made peace with one another, and the elders said to us, “Go and play.”
At that I said to Perpetua, “You have what you want.” She answered me, “Thanks be to God. As I was cheerful in the body, so I am more cheerful here and now.”
